state_ranges.reason: the slice fdtable holds 64 inline descriptor slots and bitmap words for 64 descriptors
a regular file of the slice holds at most the 64-byte store (file_data); the console has size 0, so every page index below the size is 0
state_ranges.validated_by: live state field inode_pool[].i_size, checked against each captured state (state_range_checks)

state_ranges.reason: tmpfs inodes use noop_backing_dev_info, whose capabilities are 0: no BDI_CAP_WRITEBACK, so balance_dirty_pages_ratelimited returns before the dirty-throttling state
the slice maps hold UID_GID_MAP_MAX_BASE_EXTENTS (5) inline extents; the sorted forward/reverse arrays of larger maps are not part of the model
futex_init sizes the hash at roundup_pow_of_two(256 * num_possible_cpus()); the slice's bucket pool holds 256 buckets (one possible CPU), so futex_hash's index hash & (hashsize - 1) stays inside it

the slice admits states where no task waits on a futex: every bucket has no waiters (and, live-checked, an empty chain), so futex_wake returns before walking a chain and a wait that queues itself faults in futex_wait_queue

each kmalloc_size_index entry is the kmalloc_caches index (KMALLOC_SHIFT_LOW..KMALLOC_SHIFT_HIGH, 3..13, or the 96- and 192-byte caches 1 and 2) of its 8-byte size class; setup_kmalloc_cache_index_table only stores such indexes; the size classes 129..192 (entries 16..23) are the kmalloc-192 cache, index 2, when KMALLOC_MIN_SIZE is at most 64 (arm64: 8)
the free pointer lies inside the 192-byte slice object (SLUB places it at ALIGN_DOWN(object_size / 2, sizeof(void *)) for caches without a constructor): offset + 8 <= object_size

input_domains.reason: a regular-file position is never negative: vfs_llseek and rw_verify_area reject negative offsets without FMODE_UNSIGNED_OFFSET, which ramfs and memfd files do not set
each file reference is held by a descriptor slot, mapping or task, so the count stays far below LONG_MAX and get_file cannot overflow
expand_fdtable sets resize_in_progress and clears it before returning within one call; with the files table not shared (a single-threaded task), no resize is in progress at a system-call boundary

klee_separate_members.reason: file reads and writes index file_data.bytes at f_pos + i; in its own KLEE object those symbolic-index accesses stay out of the rest of the context

graph_invariants.reason: between system calls of a single-threaded task no descriptor is reserved without being installed: alloc_fd sets the bit and fd_install fills the slot within one call, and close clears both, so open_fds equals the installed slots
full_fds_bits records which open_fds words are all ones (__set_open_fd and __clear_open_fd keep it in step)
next_fd is a search hint never above the lowest free descriptor: alloc_fd advances it past the allocated slot and __put_unused_fd/close lower it to the freed one
